Remove some species from the model

Source: R/reef-helpers.R
removeSpecies.mizerReef.Rd

This extends mizer's removeSpecies() to also remove the relevant row from the detritus and algae consumption arrays rho.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'mizerReef'
removeSpecies(params, species, ...)

Arguments

params

A mizerReef object

species

The species to be removed. A vector of species names, or a numeric vector of species indices, or a logical vector indicating for each species whether it is to be removed (TRUE) or not.

...

Unused

Value

A mizerReef object with fewer species.
